title: Spicy Tofu Veggie Tacos
ingredients: 1 tbsp nutritional yeast (optional, adds protein & umami)
1. Prep tofu: Press tofu for 10–15 minutes (or pat dry with a towel), then crumble with your hands or a fork.
2. Sauté base: In a large skillet, heat olive oil. Add onion and garlic, cook 2 minutes. Add bell pepper and zucchini, sauté 3–4 more minutes.
3. mix olive oil, seasonings and soy sauce in tofu. Mix it into the onion garlic.
4. Warm tortillas: Heat in a dry skillet or microwave.
5. Assemble tacos: Add tofu-veggie filling and your favorite toppings.
Want a meal prep version that stores well too?

Yes! Japanese lamb curry with potatoes is a delicious and comforting twist on the classic Japanese kare raisu (カレーライス) — usually made with beef or pork, but lamb works beautifully. It’s savory, slightly sweet, thick, and mild — perfect with rice.
